_populated_for: TESTS STATE ACROSS FRAMES. Needs track_id to match the same object between prev and curr, which object_detection provides because the tracker is attached.
name: line_crossing
description: Emit when a tracked object crosses a configured line.
rule: A track crossed when the sign of sideOfLine changes between the previous frame and the current one for the same track_id; direction is in when the previous side was negative, otherwise out.
